snapshot.title: Rebuild Expo↔Godot sync pipeline
snapshot.description: Replace the current cross-bridge sync mechanism with a reliable, bidirectional, single-source-of-truth approach. Remove existing sync code and tests that are part of the current approach. Related: @.knowns/tasks/task-8t0o83

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bidirectional data sync (Expo→Godot and Godot→Expo) is reliable and lossless for defined state
Legacy sync code/tests removed
New tests cover bidirectional sync
CI workflow builds Godot export and Expo build on main

changes.newValue:
1. Replace legacy sync helpers in RN + Godot with a snapshot/patch SyncBridge autoload and a JS sync client.
2. Update screens/components to use the new sync state store + loop; remove old queue/polling.
3. Add Godot headless sync tests + Jest sync-state tests and wire into CI; add export/build workflow.
